design.motif: A pocket-compass mapmaker's surface: tightly woven linen under fine laid paper, shallow partial bearing arcs and one open crosshair-like registration pair near an edge. Sparse tactile cartographic marks, without a compass rose, actual map, names, numbers or arrows.

description.en: Tightly woven linen under fine laid paper, shallow partial bearing arcs and one open crosshair-like registration pair near an edge.
description.zh: 亚麻衬纸上的局部方位弧与开放定位线，回应随身罗盘，也把查找位置变成安静的阅读过程。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: A small, fast IP lookup service, built with Bun and TypeScript.
description.zh: 用 Bun 与 TypeScript 构建的轻量 IP 查询服务。

purpose.en: Give network diagnostic tools IP location and network data, plus observations of DNS resolver exit addresses.
purpose.zh: 为网络诊断工具提供 IP 位置与运营商信息，并观察 DNS 解析器的出口地址。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
